content:
I build backend systems that businesses run on every day: a farm management system used across 32 pig farms by about 1,000 people, contract transactions for 70 FPT Telecom branches, and FMS Aqua, now running about 40 fish ponds.

My strength is the work behind the screen: SQL performance, clean APIs, security, and system integration. I’ve connected SAP, Solomon, Odoo, MoMo, and banking APIs, kept every query inside a 20-second DBA timeout on telecom-scale data, and issued around 130 e-invoices a day with no invoicing errors.

I mostly work in .NET with SQL Server and Postgres, pick up React when a feature needs it, and lately build with Claude Code. On the side I ship freelance products end to end, like DBL Store: 800 users and 1,433 orders.

Open to freelance projects and backend roles. Got a messy problem? Let’s talk.
favoriteWin: Growing bulk inserts from about 10,000 to 140,000 rows per batch by passing XML lists straight into SQL Server stored procedures, a technique I used at FPT Telecom, VietCredit, and GreenFeed.
